问数内容: 按时间段、领用机构、票种、查询出库或入库的份数、号段、入库状态
sql（要包含必传条件，如开票日期）:
-- oracle:按时间段、领用机构、票种、查询出库的份数、号段、入库状态 
select stock.fdate as "日期",
         nvl(a.fagenname, r.fname)   as "领用机构",
         b.fname  as "票据名称",
         item1.fnumber  as "数量",
         item1.fbillno1 as "起始号",
         item1.fbillno2 as "终止号",
         case when stock.fchangestate = '1' then '未审核'
            when stock.fchangestate = '2' then '审核退回'
            when stock.fchangestate = '3' then '已审核'
            when stock.fchangestate = '31' then '不需要审核'
            when stock.fchangestate = '15' then '已出库'
            when stock.fchangestate = '8' then '已入库'
            when stock.fchangestate = '6' then '已写卡'
           end as  "入库状态"
  from fbe_stock_out stock
  left join fbe_stock_out_item item1 on stock.fid = item1.fpid
  left join fab_agen a on a.fagenidcode = stock.fagencode and a.fisfinal = '1'
  left join afa_auth_region r on r.fcode = stock.fagencode
  left join fab_bill b on b.fid = item1.fbillid
  where stock.frgncode = '出库区划编码' 
and stock.fdate >= '起始日期' and stock.fdate  <= '终止日期' 
and  b.fname = '票据名称' and nvl(a.fagenname, r.fname)  = '机构名称';

         r.fname   as "领用机构",
         b.fname  as "票据名称",
         item1.fnumber  as "数量",
         item1.fbillno1 as "起始号",
         item1.fbillno2 as "终止号",
         stock.fchangestate,
         case when stock.fchangestate = '3' then '已审核'
            when stock.fchangestate = '31' then '不需审核'
            when stock.fchangestate = '9' then '已入库确认'
           end as  "入库状态"
  from fbe_stock_in stock

  left join afa_auth_region r on r.fcode = stock.frgncode
  left join fab_bill b on b.fid = item1.fbillid

  and stock.frgncode = '出库区划编码'  
and stock.fdate >= '起始日期' and stock.fdate  <= '终止日期' 
and  b.fname = '票据名称' ;

--oracle:按时间段（年\月\周等）、区划、单位、票种查询票据核销情况，包括本期情况，累计情况；
SELECT DISTINCT SUMALL.FRGNCODE as "区划编码",
                    AGEN.FAGENCODE as "单位编码",
                    AGEN.FAGENNAME as  "单位名称",
                    DICT.FNAME  as "计量单位",
                    BILL.FBILLCODE as "票据编码" ,
                    BILL.FBILLNAME  as "票据名称",
                    THIS.FNUMBER as "本期数量",
                    THIS.FAMT as "本期审验金额",
                    THIS.FINVNUM as "本期份数",
                    SUMALL.FALLNUMBER as "累计审验数量",
                    SUMALL.FALLAMT as "累计审验金额",
                    SUMALL.FALLINVNUM as "累计审验份数"
      FROM (SELECT WO.FRGNCODE,
                        WO.FAGENIDCODE,
                        ITEM.FBILLID,
                        SUM(ITEM.FNUMBER) AS FALLNUMBER,
                        SUM(ITEM.FAMT) AS FALLAMT,
                        SUM(ITEM.FINVNUM) AS FALLINVNUM
                   FROM FBE_WRITEOFF WO
                   LEFT JOIN FBE_WRITEOFF_BILLITEM ITEM
                     ON ITEM.FPID = WO.FID
                  WHERE WO.FRGNCODE = '区划编码' AND WO.FCHANGESTATE = '2' 
                  --- AND WO.FAGENIDCODE='单位识别码'
                  -- AND ITEM.FBILLID='票据ID'
                  GROUP BY WO.FRGNCODE, WO.FAGENIDCODE, ITEM.FBILLID) SUMALL
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT WO.FRGNCODE,
                        WO.FAGENIDCODE,
                        ITEM.FBILLID,
                        SUM(ITEM.FNUMBER) AS FNUMBER,
                        SUM(ITEM.FAMT) AS FAMT,
                        SUM(ITEM.FINVNUM) AS FINVNUM
                   FROM FBE_WRITEOFF WO
                   LEFT JOIN FBE_WRITEOFF_BILLITEM ITEM
                     ON ITEM.FPID = WO.FID
                  WHERE WO.FRGNCODE ='区划编码' AND WO.FCHANGESTATE = '2' 
                 --AND WO.FDATE >='开始日期'
                 --WO.FDATE<= '结束日期'
                 --AND WO.FAGENIDCODE= '单位识别码'
                 --AND ITEM.FBILLID= '票据ID'
                  GROUP BY WO.FRGNCODE,WO.FAGENIDCODE, ITEM.FBILLID) THIS
        ON SUMALL.FRGNCODE = THIS.FRGNCODE
       AND THIS.FAGENIDCODE = SUMALL.FAGENIDCODE
       AND THIS.FBILLID = SUMALL.FBILLID
      LEFT JOIN V_FAB_BILLAGEN AGEN ON AGEN.FAGENIDCODE = SUMALL.FAGENIDCODE
      LEFT JOIN V_FAB_BILL BILL ON SUMALL.FBILLID = BILL.FID
      LEFT JOIN FBA_DICT DICT ON DICT.FOBJ = 'BILL_UNITS'
      WHERE BILL.FUNITS = DICT.FCODE
      ORDER BY AGEN.FAGENCODE, BILL.FBILLCODE
